files.description: CURRENT (not historical-evidence-frozen) UDK K/DST source, all 32 teams' K + DST, verified byte-correct UTF-8 (including diacritics -- 'Eddy Piñeiro' decodes correctly; an earlier session doc wrongly called this mojibake, corrected in KDST_AND_UNIVERSE_GAP_EVIDENCE_20260903.md). Parsed by src/services/udk_unmodeled_skill_asset_service.py's parse_udk_kdst_snapshot(). Closes the Harrison Mevis vs. stale 'Joshua Karty' gap in live_manual_kdst_assets_64.json -- that file stays untouched as real live-draft-night evidence; this is a separate, current source for new/future drafts.

Real live NWR Redraft runtime draft board for the 2026 KHA High Stakes League. mode=LIVE_READ_ONLY, owner_slot=9, 157/192 picks recorded, last touched 2026-09-02 22:28 MDT. Byte-identical to the source app-data file and to its own .backup.json twin at capture time.
App-maintained backup twin of the file above, confirmed byte-identical.

Verbatim copy of the owner's platform-exported draft recap (raw scraped page export, includes site-chrome header/footer rows). Confirmed byte-identical to the owner's separately preserved original export ('2026 KHA High Stakes League Fantasy Football - Sheet1 - Copy.csv').

Cleaned, replay-ready derivative: 192 rows, columns overall_pick,round,pick_in_round,team_slot,team_name,player_name,nfl_team,position. team_slot derived from round-1 draft order (snake). Deterministic parse, no player/pick data invented or altered.

Owner draft-prep UDK skill-position snapshot (315 rows) with an existing identity-reconciliation pass against the real KHA draft-day NWR universe: identity_status is MATCHED (301) or UNMATCHED (14) per row, plus nwr_player_id/match_method/match_confidence. The 14 UNMATCHED rows are the seed data for the missing-skill-player manual asset ingestion in src/services/udk_unmodeled_skill_asset_service.py -- includes all 5 historical OWNER_PLACEHOLDER_FOR_MISSING_PLAYER picks plus 9 more not yet hit by this draft.

Real live NWR manual K/DST asset pool for the KHA profile at draft time: 32 K + 32 DST, practical_mode=true so this was actually loaded and exposed to the Draft Room during the live draft. Proves the 14 historical K_DST_UNREPRESENTABLE picks were a discoverability/UI failure (position filter had to already be K or DST to see these), not a missing-data failure -- see docs/codex/KDST_AND_UNIVERSE_GAP_EVIDENCE_20260903.md and tests/test_kha_reconciliation_regression.py.
